query:
UPDATE offer_slots
            SET
                label           = COALESCE($2, label),
                min_items       = COALESCE($3, min_items),
                max_items       = COALESCE($4, max_items),
                supplement_cents = COALESCE($5, supplement_cents),
                slot_group      = $6,
                position        = $7
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING
                id,
                offer_id,
                label as "label: Name",
                min_items,
                max_items,
                supplement_cents,
                position,
                slot_group
